name: Michigan Public Universities — Senior Tuition Discounts (60+, varies by campus)
discount: Free audit courses at Central Michigan, Lake Superior State, and Michigan Tech (60+); 50% off tuition at University of Michigan (65+); 75% off at Wayne State (60+); full scholarships/one free class at Northern Michigan and Western Michigan (62+)
conditions: Michigan has no single statewide law — each public university sets its own senior program and age cutoff; contact the specific campus registrar for exact terms.

name: Ohio Public Colleges — Program 60 (60+)
discount: Tuition-free, noncredit, space-available course enrollment
conditions: Ohio residents 60+ per Ohio Senate Bill 497; instructor permission and space-available basis; does not count toward a degree; course/lab fees may still apply; offered under various names at each state-supported college.

name: Virginia Public Universities — Senior Citizens Higher Education Act (60+)
discount: Free audit of any course regardless of income; free for-credit enrollment if prior-year taxable income was under ~$23,850
conditions: Must be a Virginia resident domiciled in-state for at least 1 year, per Code of Virginia §23.1-640; tuition-paying students get registration priority; course-materials fees still apply.

name: New York SUNY System — Senior Auditor Waiver (60+)
discount: Audit credit-bearing courses tuition-free
conditions: NY residents 60+ per NY State Education Law Article 126 §6303; space-available basis; individual SUNY campuses may charge modest registration/ID fees; no academic credit awarded.

name: California State University System — Over 60 Program
discount: Tuition waived at all 23 CSU campuses
conditions: California residents 60+; application, health services, and related activity fees still apply (reduced to $1 for some fees); space-available, non-degree enrollment.

name: South Carolina Public Colleges & Universities — Senior Citizen Tuition Exemption (60+)
discount: Tuition-free enrollment on a space-available basis
conditions: SC residents for at least 12 months, 60+; registration only confirmed on the first day of class once space is known; technology, lab, matriculation, and program fees are not waived.

name: Pennsylvania State System & Penn State — Senior Tuition Waivers (60+)
discount: Up to 6 credits per semester tuition-free (Penn State Go-60); PASSHE schools offer similar 60+ waivers for audit or credit
conditions: PA residents 60+ who are retired or working no more than 20 hrs/week (Penn State); fees, labs, and textbooks not covered; each PASSHE school (West Chester, Shippensburg, California University of PA, etc.) administers its own version.

name: Washington State Community & Technical Colleges — Senior Citizen Tuition Waiver (60+)
discount: Tuition and services/activities fees waived for up to 2 courses per quarter/semester
conditions: WA residents 60+ enrolled for credit, per RCW 28B.15.540; space-available basis, no new sections created for waiver students; college may charge up to $5/quarter nominal fee.

discount: 75% off general daytime admission
conditions: Requires a free Age Friendly Seattle Gold Card (WA residents 60+, apply online or call 206-684-0648); daytime admission only, excludes separately ticketed events.
